questions.question: When a royal official heard Jesus had come to Galilee, what did he do to ask Jesus to heal his dying son?
When Jesus told a royal official "Your son will live," what did the official do?

answers.text: Took Jesus at His word and left
Waited until Jesus agreed to come
Sent a servant ahead to check first

questions.question: A royal official's sick son got better. What did the father realize about the hour the fever left?

answers.text: It was when Jesus said his son would live
It was when he set out to find Jesus
It was when the boy's fever first began
